description: This file defines types, constants, enums, and structures related to 5G NR RAN, including PDU session IDs, RAN UE IDs, QoS support, security indications, and PDU session types, with associated utility functions and formatters.

classes.name: pdu_session_id_t
classes.description: Enum class representing PDU Session IDs with valid range 0..255 and an invalid value.

classes.name: ran_ue_id_t
classes.description: Enum class representing RAN UE IDs with valid range 0..2^32-1 and an invalid value.

classes.name: security_indication_t
classes.description: Struct containing security indication enums for integrity and confidentiality, with helper functions.

methods.name: pdu_session_id_to_uint
methods.description: Converts a PDU session ID enum to its underlying integer value.

methods.name: uint_to_pdu_session_id
methods.description: Converts an integer to a PDU session ID enum.

methods.name: ran_ue_id_to_uint
methods.description: Converts a RAN UE ID enum to its underlying integer value.

methods.name: uint_to_ran_ue_id
methods.description: Converts an integer to a RAN UE ID enum.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to set the appropriate security indication enum value.

methods.name: security_result_required
methods.description: Checks if a security result should be sent based on security indication.
